rows.details: Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJMU), Kanpur (formerly Kanpur University)
Senior Server Administrator, Junior Server Administrator, Technical Assistant, Data Entry Operator, Junior Establishment Officer, AI Developer, Physiotherapy Rehabilitation Coordinator
Contractual, under Self-Finance Scheme (SFS), for 3 years, not beyond age 60

content_sections.heading: CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should complete their CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Apply Online process well before the last date, as incomplete applications or those submitted without the required certificates and documents will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The CSJMU Non Teaching Vacancy 2026 is spread across the School of Engineering & Technology, School of Health Sciences, School of Hotel Management, and School of Business Management. The table below lists each post, the number of vacancies, and the category-wise break-up as given in the official notification. Within the Data Entry Operator post, the sub-department allocation under School of Engineering & Technology is: Computer Science & Engineering (01), Computer Application (02), Electrical Engineering (01), Mechanical Engineering (01), and Vocational Studies (01).

content_sections.heading: CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility for the CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 differs post-wise. Candidates should carefully match their qualification and experience against the specific post before applying, as the notification does not describe candidates as generally eligible - each post has distinct essential and desirable qualifications.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduation or post-graduation in Information Technology or a related field, with a minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in Data Center Operations. Proficiency in cloud technologies, Active Directory, virtualization platforms (Hyper-V/VMware), Linux and Windows server administration, Sophos Firewall, SAN storage management, IT support, and infrastructure monitoring tools is required.
Graduation/Diploma with 2 years of relevant experience, and knowledge of Microsoft, Druze, Active Directory, virtualization, and Linux/Windows servers.
3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. Knowledge of CAD software and CNC programming is preferred.
Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university, with a CCC Certificate or DCA and at least 2 years of experience. Sound knowledge of MS Office and meeting software is required.
Bachelor's degree (minimum 50% marks) in any discipline or equivalent higher qualification from a recognized university/institution, with 3-5 years of administrative experience in office management.

BCA / B.Tech (Computer Science/IT) / B.E. (CSE) or equivalent degree. Desirable: strong interest in AI, Machine Learning, and automation; basic-to-intermediate Python programming; familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn; knowledge of APIs, databases, and web technologies.

15 years of experience in Physiotherapy with a degree, OR 20 years of experience in clinical and supervisory work in a Physiotherapy department of a university or government hospital. Registration with the State Medical Faculty is required.

content_sections.heading: CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online along with the application form. It is non-refundable once submitted. Candidates applying for more than one position must apply separately and pay the application fee for each application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply must complete the CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Apply Online process on the Samarth portal linked through the university's official websites, www.kanpuruniversity.org and www.csjmu.ac.in. Visit the official university website and open the Samarth-based online application portal. Read the General Information and Instructions carefully before filling the form. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details. Note that once data is entered and submitted, it cannot be changed, so candidates should verify all entries before final submission. Upload scanned copies (in PDF) of all supporting documents for claims made in the application, such as eligibility, achievements, and publications (first page only, where applicable). A merged single PDF is suggested for mark sheets and certificates/degrees. SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates must also enclose a hard copy of their Caste/Income Certificate on the prescribed Uttar Pradesh Government format at the time of application or interview. Candidates already in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) either at the time of online application or at the time of interview. Pay the prescribed application fee online along with the application. Submit the application before the last date, 30 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: CSJMU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 Other Important Points
content_sections.text: Experience and qualifications will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the application form. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. No claim for regular appointment or regularization will be entertained at any stage; the appointment is contractual under the Self-Finance Scheme. Reservation for the posts follows Uttar Pradesh State Government norms. The university reserves the right to withdraw any advertised post at any time without assigning a reason, choose not to fill any advertised position, or increase/decrease the number of posts. If any submitted document is found false, fake, or incorrect at any stage of verification (before or after appointment), the appointment based on that document will be terminated. Candidates are advised to fill absolute numerical values (not decimals or fractions) while completing the online form. Candidates with qualifications in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Commerce, Management, Physiotherapy and other relevant fields can also explore more Non Teaching Government Jobs and University Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for opportunities in Uttar Pradesh can also explore the latest Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs and Kanpur Government Jobs . Those interested in technical and IT-related positions can check more Computer Science Jobs, IT Government Jobs and Technical Assistant Jobs matching their qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur, to fill 18 contractual Non-Teaching positions across seven posts under the Self-Finance Scheme (SFS), as per Advertisement No. CSJMU/SFS/973/2026 dated 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies in total, spread across Senior Server Administrator, Junior Server Administrator, Technical Assistant, Data Entry Operator, Junior Establishment Officer, AI Developer/AI Implementation Coder, and Physiotherapy Rehabilitation Coordinator posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 September 2026. The application window opened on 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post, ranging from a diploma in mechanical engineering (Technical Assistant) to postgraduate/graduate degrees in IT with specific years of experience (Server Administrator posts) to specialized clinical experience (Physiotherapy Rehabilitation Coordinator). See the eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A specific age limit is not mentioned in the notification. The contractual appointment period is 3 years and is capped at not beyond 60 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹1,000/- for general/UR/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹750/- for SC/ST candidates, payable online with the application.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the Samarth portal accessible via www.kanpuruniversity.org or www.csjmu.ac.in, along with the application fee and scanned supporting documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSJMU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process differs by post: skill test plus written examination for Server Administrator, Technical Assistant, and Data Entry Operator posts; written examination, presentation, and interview (60:20:20) for Junior Establishment Officer; interview only for AI Developer; and skill assessment plus interview for Physiotherapy Rehabilitation Coordinator.
